blocks.content: In a complete graph, every pair of vertices is directly connected by an edge. Consider the graph below:
Here, vertex 0 and vertex 1 are connected by a distinct edge. Similarly, distinct edges connect vertex 0 to vertex 2 and vertex 3.

blocks.alt: Each Vertices are Connected Distinct Edge

blocks.content: The same applies to other vertices—each one is connected to another directly within the graph.

blocks.alt: Each Vertices are Connected Distinct Edge

blocks.content: Note: A complete graph with n vertices has n*(n-1)/2 edges.
